crossRefs.note: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;
But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath?…
Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved,
that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example…
All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us…
Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being…
By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through…
In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
translations.bsb: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
translations.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
translations.asv: But God commendeth his own love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
